name: Cosmic Soul Adept
body:
As an initiate into spiritual cultivation and training, you have unlocked the first cosmic secret, allowing you to collect and harness your mental energy to temporarily explore the world around you.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment, Wis 13, and ki pool or 1st-level power with daily uses from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain. You must also possess 10 ranks in Spellcraft and have either Skill Focus (Spellcraft), Spell Penetration, or Void Magic Adept.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the cosmic senses ability.

This allows you to project your consciousness outside of your body, creating a supernatural sensor. This sensor allows you to perceive from its position, similar to using a spell of the scrying subschool. Where applicable, your effective caster level for cosmic senses is equal to your HD and the effective spell level of cosmic senses is equal to 1/2 your HD, maximum 9th level.

Cosmic Senses (Su)

Once per day, as a standard action, you may activate this ability for 1 minute. Each time you activate this ability, the maximum distance from your body that your sensor can explore while this ability lasts is dependent on the number of ranks in Spellcraft you possess. You also gain a general understanding of the terrain’s layout, including the general locations of buildings and structures that are not deliberately concealed or hidden in their immediate surroundings, within this maximum distance. This general understanding is similar to having a mundane map in hand.

Unlike most spells of the scrying subschool, you cannot perceive across planar or dimensional boundaries via this sensor, not even through a visible portal, into another location. This sensor is intangible, imperceptible, and cannot trigger traps or other effects with similar trigger conditions.

You choose a starting location for your sensor when you activate cosmic senses. Any time during this ability’s duration, you may reposition the sensor at will as a move action to another location within its maximum range.

Unlike most sensors, cosmic senses allow you to make any observational actions with your normal senses as if you were there. Such actions include, but not limited to, feeling objects, smelling scents, noticing atmospheric or temperature conditions, and making certain checks with skills like Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, or even Spellcraft. For example, using Spellcraft to identify spells being cast or using Perception to check for secret doors.

Spellcraft Ranks	Sensor’s Max Distance from You
10	Up to 1 mile
12	Up to 5 miles
14	Up to 25 miles
16	Up to 100 miles
18 or more	Up to 500 miles

With cosmic senses, you can only utilize your normal senses derived from your physiology (including via a current polymorph effect on you) through the sensor.

This does not extend to any additional senses granted by any external source that does not have the polymorph descriptor (including divination spells) or by any magic item (including artifacts).

While you are utilizing cosmic senses to remotely observe in this way, your body cannot take physical actions (treat as flat-footed but not helpless). You may switch between observing with your sensor or observing with your body as a move action as often as desired within the duration.

This ability does not count as a divination or scrying effect; it cannot be noticed or foiled by any other effect that affects divination or scrying effects, including (but not limited to) detect scrying, false vision, and nondetection.

For the purposes of any illusion effect you notice with cosmic senses, you may only gain a chance to disbelieve it if your sensor spends at least one round within 60 feet of the illusion.

Special: You may expend 3 ki points or 3 daily uses of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain to regain your daily use of cosmic senses. You may only regain your daily use of cosmic senses in this way once for every 7 HD you possess. Alternatively, you may expend 1 ki point or 1 daily use of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain as a free action on your turn to extend the current duration of your active cosmic senses by an additional minute.

Special: Non-spellcasting characters with at least 7 levels in a monk class (including a class that lists monk as a parent class) can qualify for this feat earlier instead with 7 ranks in Spellcraft and Skill Focus (Spellcraft). Until they gain a ki pool (or a 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain with daily uses), such a character can only use cosmic senses once per day (sensor’s maximum range is 1 mile until the character qualifies for longer range).
